caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of plaid cloth centered on a plain, off-white background. The cloth is composed of a woven pattern featuring alternating bands of blue and red. The primary color of the cloth is blue, which forms the majority of the background in the square. The blue is intersected by evenly spaced, vertical and horizontal lines in dark blue and bright red, creating a grid or plaid pattern. The red lines are more prominent and overlap the blue lines, dividing the cloth into nine visible rectangular sections. The edges of the cloth are frayed, with individual threads protruding at the borders. The drawing is enclosed within a faint, hand-drawn square border, and below the image the handwritten words "Plaid Homespun Cloth" appear on the left, with "By Clyde Cheney" written on the right.
title: Plaid Homespun Cloth
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
